messages:
claire_partners: Heads-up  Tractus Logistics signed a co-sell + Private deployment agreement (VPC) and we're live on the partner listing. They also greenlit a short technical case study focusing on our Private offering.

tom_sales: Awesome news. Do we have pilot metrics? Any infra asks for the Private rollout?

reena_cs: Pilot summary: after pinning the model version and enabling per-tenant KV caching, Tractus saw a 30% reduction in inference cost and p95 latency for their route-optimization endpoint dropped from ~700ms to ~190ms. They required KMS integration and E2E audit logs  all set.

jana_marketing: Great numbers. Are we cleared to use their logo and a 1-sentence quote? Need approvals to draft the blog and partner page.

claire_partners: Legal approved the co-marketing SOW and signed logo consent. They prefer the case study to highlight VPC deployment and HSM key management.

eng-bot: note: deployment_run: tructus_private_prod completed by infra-team at 1790001289.

jana_marketing: Can engineering provide a 2-line technical blurb (what we changed) and a screenshot of the audit log timeline? Need assets by Tue.

reena_cs: I'll collect the customer quote and request a 1-sentence testimonial from their Head of Platform.

claire_partners: Ops: can you create a task and attach the signed SOW + KMS integration doc?

ops-bot: task created: "Tractus Private case study & partner listing"  assignees: jana_marketing, infra-team, reena_cs. Due: 2026-09-02. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4682

tom_sales: For enablement: let's add a short checklist for procurement (VPC peering, cert handshake, deployment window). I'll draft the one-pager and add to the task.

claire_partners: Also note: Tractus asked for a short appendix on model pinning + rollback policy for regulated flows. Mike from infra will supply config snippets.

reena_cs: Customer prefers a gated case study but ok with a partner spotlight blurb on the partner page.

jana_marketing: Plan: partner spotlight + gated technical case study + social. Posting drafts to #marketing-review by Monday.

claire_partners: We'll mention this at next all-hands as a Private deployment marquee win. Thanks everyone :tada:
